dimensions.note: No credentials, global configuration, providers, or network integrations.
The sole method logs structured entry and successful stored or replay completion without feedback content.
Contract, privacy, and replay validation precede the sole write; read and write failures propagate without authority or success output.
Synthetic success, privacy rejection, deterministic output, tamper, malformed input, failure, no-authority surface, and idempotent/conflicting replay are tested.
Exact response replay performs no write; changed content under the same response ID is rejected before persistence.
No external API, HTTP, command, route, or provider contract exists.
No external resources, files, connections, publish/send operations, or closure capability exist.
README and source use generic synthetic identifiers and state redaction limitations and human-review boundaries.
All input, nested, decision, and output objects are strict; cross-field provenance, timing, redaction, praise, and draft-disposition invariants are enforced.
The immutable response packet explicitly declares infinite lifetime and garbage collection retention.
This is a single immutable classify-and-draft computation, not a remote CRUD lifecycle.
The method has no external mutation; strict validation and replay checks gate its local persistence write.
The only write targets the response spec under the validated response ID; no cross-spec collision is possible.
Existing replay state is accessed only through readResource.
This is the initial standalone model version with no prior persisted schema to migrate.
